# Nagpur Property Advisor

> Premium, trust-first real estate consultancy in Nagpur. Verified properties with V-Audit™ legal checks (NMRDA/NIT, RERA, 30-year title, 7/12, possession) and a flat 2% managed brokerage.

Nagpur Property Advisor helps buyers and sellers transact residential and commercial properties — plots, flats, and bungalows — across Nagpur localities including Dharampeth, Sadar, Civil Lines, Manish Nagar, Wardha Road, Hingna, Besa, Ramdaspeth, and Sitabuldi. Every listing is independently verified before publication, and every transaction is supported end-to-end through registration.

Contact: +91 80106 15388
